state/project-init.json.notes: Finalization writes the canonical project state; later edits must preserve schema validity.

README.md.notes: Rendered from finalized state and safe to regenerate when state changes.

CHANGELOG.md.notes: Seeded from the base template plus initial entry, then maintained by the project.

.gitignore.notes: Regenerated when the selected stack or persistence choice changes.

.github/workflows/ci.yml.notes: Rendered from finalized state commands as a baseline CI guardrail.

docs/ROADMAP.md.notes: Rendered from state, then milestone evidence is maintained manually.

docs/ARCHITECTURE.md.notes: Rendered from state, then evolved through ADR-backed changes.

docs/FILE_MAP.md.notes: Seeded from the base template and updated as implementation files are added.

docs/GOVERNANCE_INDEX.md.notes: Seeded from the base template and updated as governance records grow.

docs/VERSIONING_AND_RELEASE_POLICY.md.notes: Seeded from the base template and changed only by explicit policy decision.

docs/SECURITY_POLICY.md.notes: Seeded from the base template and changed only by explicit policy decision.

docs/RUNTIME_VERIFICATION_REPORT.md.notes: Seeded from the base template plus command replacement, then maintained as evidence.

docs/MIGRATION_POLICY.md.notes: Rendered only when persistence is enabled; otherwise an existing generated copy is removed.

docs/adr/ADR-0001-record-architecture-de.notes: Rendered from state and superseded by later ADRs when decisions change.

docs/adr/ADR-TEMPLATE.md.notes: Seeded as the future ADR template.

IDEA_CATALOG.md.notes: Finalization marks the selected idea finalized while preserving catalog context.

NOTES_CATALOG.md.notes: Finalization archives the research-note catalog under .harness/history.

ideas/.notes: Finalization moves brainstorming idea buckets under .harness/history.

sessions/.notes: Finalization moves source and finalization sessions under .harness/history.

exports/.notes: Finalization moves optional brainstorming summary exports under .harness/history.

.harness/history/.notes: Finalization stores archived brainstorming history here so project root can hold development artifacts.

MODE.md.notes: Finalization switches the repository to development mode.

sessions/*FINALIZATION_SESSION*.md.notes: Finalization writes a timestamped session record for audit history.

exports/*PROJECT_SUMMARY*.md.notes: Finalization writes a timestamped summary export unless an existing export is reused.
